# REALIZED

> What a Uniswap v3 liquidity provider ACTUALLY earned: fees minus impermanent loss,
> computed from The Graph's historical poolDayData. DEX-advertised APR is fee income
> annualised — it has no price term, so it is positive by construction and cannot show
> a loss. This service computes the number that can.

Base URL: https://realized.drainfun.xyz
Repo: https://github.com/jiggy-cadence/realized
Library: packages/core in the repo above (plain ESM, no build step)
License: MIT

## Why The Graph is load-bearing here

Per-day fee totals in USD are derived aggregates produced by the indexer.

RPC is not impossible, and we checked rather than asserted: feeGrowthGlobal0X128 is public
pool state readable at any historical block (verified live against an archive node on
2026-09-11). What is impractical is the rest -- that accumulator is Q128 in token units, so
per-day USD needs an archive node, a block lookup per day boundary, and a historical price
for BOTH tokens at each boundary, repeated for every pool. At 256 pools across 5 chains that
is thousands of archive calls per rebuild.

The Graph publishes that join already computed and consistent. The claim is practicality,
not impossibility.

## Endpoints (GET, CORS-open, no auth, read-only)

### /api/pools
Full cached corpus. Every pool carries precomputed realizedAprPct, gapPts, misleading,
and trustLabel at the moderate (±2x) range, plus a machine-readable `schema` block and a
`testVector` you can use to self-verify your own implementation of the IL formula.

### /api/find?q=WETH/USDC&limit=6
Resolve a human pair name to a poolId. No address needed.

### /api/pool/{poolId}?dex=uniswap-v3&chain=mainnet&days=30
Advertised vs realized for one pool over a trailing window.

### /api/position/{poolId}?entry=2026-07-28&range=2
THE MAIN ONE. What a specific position actually made, from a specific entry date, at a
specific range width. Returns feeReturnPct, impermanentLossPct, realizedReturnPct,
realizedAprPct, outOfRange, dailySeries[], and a plain-language `verdict`.

### /api/wallet/{address}?dex=uniswap-v3&chain=mainnet
Which pools an address actually holds, and AT WHAT RANGE. Reads the Position entity and
resolves each position's real tick bounds, so you can stop assuming +/-2x. Feed a
position's `range.widthX` into /api/position/{poolId} for realized return at the range
the LP actually set.

This is position DISCOVERY, not per-position P&L, and that is a measured decision:
- `collectedFees*` is a WITHDRAWAL record, not an earnings record. It only populates when
  the LP calls collect(). Measured live: of 150 positions with collectedFeesToken0 == 0,
  71 had non-zero feeGrowthInside0LastX128 -- they earned fees and never collected.
  So uncollected fees return `measurable: false` with a reason, NEVER $0.
- `deposited*`/`withdrawn*` are lifetime cumulative, not entry state (75% of live
  positions read as one-sided because of it), so they are namespaced under `cumulative`
  and must not be read as position value.
Every response carries a `limits` block stating both. Token decimals ship beside the
amounts so you never have to guess the divisor.

### /api/audit?limit=250&days=30
Corpus-wide sweep with a stable-pair canary and a sensitivity table across three
liveness gates.

## MCP server

    node bin/mcp-server.js          # requires GRAPH_API_KEY

Tools:
- find_pool(query)                      — resolve "WETH/USDC" to a poolId
- realized_return(poolId, days, rangeWidthX)
- position_realized(poolId, entryDate, rangeWidthX)  — the personal question
- audit_pools(limit, days)              — corpus sweep + canary
- explain_gap(poolId)                   — plain-language verdict with evidence
- rank_pools(limit, top, rangeWidthX, excludeMisleading)
      — THE ACTIONABLE ONE. Rank by what LPs actually took home, not advertised APR.
        Each pool gets a trustLabel: "historically honest" (advertised tracked reality
        within 2pts), "gap-prone", "routinely misleading" (advertised positive while
        LPs lost money), or "unmeasurable" (never a fabricated zero).
        This is what a yield dashboard should call INSTEAD of sorting by APR.

## Library

    git clone https://github.com/jiggy-cadence/realized && cd realized && npm install

    import { gatewayUrl, fetchPoolFrom, positionRealized } from './packages/core/src/index.js';
    const pool = await fetchPoolFrom(gatewayUrl(process.env.GRAPH_API_KEY), poolId, entryTs);
    positionRealized(pool, 2).realizedReturnPct;

impermanentLossPct(r) and concentratedIlPct(r, w) are pure functions — no network, no
API key, no dependencies.

## Honesty constraints an agent should propagate

- Unmeasurable is ALWAYS reported as unmeasurable, never as zero. This applies hardest to
  wallet fees: a position that earned fees but never collected them reports
  `measurable: false`, because $0 would be a number whose label lies -- the exact defect
  this tool exists to expose, pointed at the user's own money.
- Every corpus aggregate carries a canary: stable/stable pairs must show ~0 impermanent
  loss. If the canary fails, the instrument is considered broken and rank_pools refuses
  to return a ranking rather than ranking on bad math.
- Fee uplift for concentrated ranges is NOT modelled. Tight-range realized figures are
  therefore LOWER BOUNDS. Ordering is robust; treat magnitudes as bounded.
- Fees are pool-level, not per-position. This is what a representative LP at that range
  earned, not any specific wallet.
- We do NOT claim "LPs lose to HODL". The claim is narrower and stronger: the advertised
  metric is systematically uninformative about realized outcomes for concentrated
  positions, and here is the live measurement.
